nodes.label: Architecture Lock — Non-Negotiable Stack Choices
nodes.rationale: Prevents agents from changing core architectural decisions such as ORM, async engine, or frontend framework, ensuring stability and consistency across development sessions.

nodes.label: Anti-Patterns Reference Table
nodes.rationale: Documents common mistakes such as using declarative_base(), curl in healthchecks, or in-memory mock data — and their correct alternatives — so agents avoid breaking changes.

nodes.label: Certificates and Badges on Course Completion
nodes.norm_label: certificates and badges on course completion

nodes.label: Dependency Injection via Depends(get_db)
nodes.rationale: Prevents async session leaks by delegating session lifecycle to FastAPI's DI framework instead of manually calling __anext__().

nodes.label: default_factory Anti-Pattern in mapped_column
nodes.rationale: Using default_factory= in SQLAlchemy mapped_column() causes subtle bugs; use default= instead.

nodes.label: Keyword-Extraction Quiz Fallback
nodes.rationale: If Ollama is unreachable or returns an error, the quiz endpoint automatically falls back to keyword-extraction questions. This ensures the quiz feature always returns results and never errors, even without a local LLM, at the cost of question quality.

nodes.label: Content Recommendations Engine
nodes.rationale: Scores courses not yet enrolled in by +2 for category match and +3 for difficulty one level above the user's current maximum, returning top 6 results. Rationale: lightweight scoring avoids a full ML recommendation system while still providing personalised suggestions.

nodes.label: Certificate Issuance (SHA-256)
nodes.rationale: Certificate number is derived as SHA-256 of user_id + course_id, making it deterministic and unique per user-course pair. Re-issuing returns the same certificate, preventing duplicates.

nodes.label: Optional Authentication Pattern (get_optional_user)
nodes.rationale: Endpoints like /dashboard and /recommendations work for anonymous users but return richer, personalised data when a token is present. Using get_optional_user (returns User | None) instead of get_current_user (raises 401) avoids locking out unauthenticated visitors while still enabling personalisation.

nodes.label: FastAPI Router-per-Domain Pattern
nodes.rationale: One router file per domain (auth, courses, quiz, study_plan, dashboard, certificates, recommendations, forum, assignments, health) keeps routing code cohesive and the overall structure predictable.

nodes.label: SQLAlchemy default_factory Anti-Pattern
nodes.rationale: mapped_column does not support default_factory. Using it silently creates a shared mutable object across all model instances, causing data corruption bugs. Use default= (e.g. default=list, default=dict, default=uuid.uuid4) instead.

nodes.label: create_all vs Alembic Migration Strategy
nodes.rationale: Base.metadata.create_all runs on startup in development for convenience, but can conflict with Alembic migrations (DuplicateTable errors). In production, disable create_all and rely exclusively on Alembic for schema management.

nodes.label: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL Build-Time Baking
nodes.rationale: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL is baked into the JavaScript bundle at build time by Next.js. Changing it requires a full frontend rebuild, not just a restart. This is a Next.js architectural constraint, not a project choice.
